# Version 3.119.5 (Unreleased)
> **Servicing line head**

## Highlights

Head of the 3.119.x servicing line — a WinUI DLL-resolution fix and an Apple TFM backport have landed so far.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **WinUI Projection DLL not found fixed for .NET 9 consumers** — The WinUI3 projection DLL was not being found at runtime under .NET 9, causing startup failures for consumers on the v3 servicing line. ([#4086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4086))

## Platform

- **Backported Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app TFMs** — The Apple TFM corrections from the v4 line (versioned TFMs for libraries, unversioned for apps) have been backported to the v3 servicing line. — ❤️ [@drasticactions](https://github.com/drasticactions) ([#4579](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4579))
